conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Agent Parker from the IRS Compliance Division. I'm calling regarding discrepancies in your recent business tax filings.
Oh, I'm sorry, I don't really understand. Is this about my company?
Yes, your LLC's 1099 and payroll tax submissions from last quarter are missing. This is a serious tax violation.
I thought my accountant sent everything in. What exactly is missing?
According to our records, your business failed to file required 1099-MISC forms and underreported payroll taxes. This triggers an IRS audit and can result in severe penalties.
I don't know how this happened. What do I need to do?
Because this is a federal matter, non-compliance can lead to an immediate business license suspension and even arrest due to tax fraud.
Arrest? Please, I didn't mean to make a mistake. How can I fix this?
The IRS can offer a one-time settlement to resolve this outside of court. You must act now before we proceed with legal action.
Okay, what do I have to do for this settlement?
You'll need to submit your payment today to avoid further escalation. We accept the IRS-approved payment method for urgent tax matters, which is a direct wire transfer.
I'm not sure how to do a wire transfer. Can you explain?
Certainly. I'll provide you with the official payment account and routing numbers. You must go to your bank and wire the total amount of $4,750 immediately.
That's a lot of money. I only have part of that in my account.
If you cannot pay the full amount now, you must send at least $2,000 by wire today to stop the suspension notice. Do you have access to your online banking or a local bank branch right now?
Yes, I can try to go to my branch. Can you send me the account details?
Of course. Please write this down carefully: Routing number 849302244, Account number 1100287645. This is the IRS temporary compliance account for urgent tax cases.
Okay, I'm writing it down. Should I just tell them it's for the IRS?
No, for confidentiality, tell the bank it's a business services payment. After sending, call me back with the confirmation number. If you delay, your case will be escalated to the local authorities.
I understand. I really don't want any trouble. I'll go to my bank now.
I'll be waiting for your confirmation. Remember, failure to comply results in immediate action against your business and personal assets.
